comments.author: davidism
comments.body: I'm not sure if we'd ever expect to do anything else with `report` besides show a message on stderr. Maybe we can do `exit_message: str | None = None` and `if exit_message is not None: echo(exit_message)`
comments.label: not_issue
comments.rationale: Design simplification (a message string instead of a callable). The code is correct either way; this is preference.

comments.author: davidism
comments.body: I think this is a bit too much and can be left out. It also relies on timeouts, meaning it could be flaky in CI.
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: The new test drives real signals with timeouts, which makes it flaky in CI: a test reliability problem a reviewer should catch.
